content:
incident-bot: Pager alert -> P0: spike in 5xx for /v1/generate in eu-west (avg 28% over 3m). Auto-escalation: oncall -> alex.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: release/geo-edge-rollout finished 2024-11-02T09:03Z. Target weight eu-west bumped from 12% -> 40% during canary.

alex: ack. I'm oncall, looking. Pulling logs and traces, paging infra + ops.

mike: seeing a subset of edge proxies in eu-west still resolving to blue-backend-1. Control-plane reports weight at 40% but DNS snapshots show some clients pinned to old IPs. TTLs are 600s.

priya: fwiw error pattern looks like backend 502s and streaming timeouts. This smells like partial config/sticky routing rather than an app regression.

alex: confirming: errors correlate with requests hitting blue-backend-1 which failed a health check after the rollout started.

mike: I can force route to green but DNS TTL will cause residual hits for a while. Recommend kill flag + immediate routing command.

alex: starting mitigation: flipping geo-rollout flag to OFF and kicking rollback job.

alex: running command:
```
POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
{"flag":"geo-rollout","state":"off"}
```

deploy-bot: rollback job #452 triggered by alex. Route controller: applying green=100% -> eu-west.

ops-bot: note: DNS TTL 600s -> some clients (ISP caches) may continue hitting blue for ~10m. Edge cache invalidation in progress.

clara: product note: CS queue spiking, approx 12 tickets from EU customers reporting generation failures and partial responses. Impact: degraded for EU customers, severity P1->P0 while active.

priya: agree keep incident P0 until 5xx < 1% and latency normalized. Also recommend adding temporary 503 fallback in front of blue-backend to reduce client retries.

mike: invalidated edge cache for blue-backend-1, executed:
`infra ctl route weight --region eu-west --green 100 --force`
Command returned OK.

alex: metrics update: within 90s of route change 5xx dropped to 4%, now 2% at T+4m. Latency trending down.

clara: notifying affected customers with post-incident note: describing rollback + mitigation, ETA for full resolution ~10-15m due to DNS TTL.

priya: documented immediate RCA notes in incident doc: partial rollout + stale DNS/ISP caches caused pinned traffic to unhealthy blue nodes -> health checks failed -> 5xx spike. Mitigation: flag kill, rollback, edge invalidation.

alex: handoff: I'll be passing to night oncall @sam in 20m. Handoff summary -> rollback completed, watch eu-west 5xx for residuals, DNS TTL could cause small tail. All rollback commands & flags logged.

sam: ack. I'll monitor charts and alerts. Please ping if anything resurfaces. :thumbsup:

clara: creating incident channel + scheduling postmortem with infra + deploy owners.

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated (active mitigation complete). Paging suppressed.

alex: closing loop here. Follow-ups: reduce DNS TTL for future rollouts, add preflight to detect partial DNS pinning, add canary stop if backend health < threshold.
